title: 首都 · Capital
subject: the capital city of a kingdom on completely flat level ground, no hill and no rock anywhere, AT THE EXACT CENTRE a vast and imposing royal palace-castle of pale ashlar with a tall square donjon, long ranges of steep blue slate roofs, round corner towers with conical caps and long banners, its own inner wall and gatehouse around it, and AROUND IT THE WHOLE CITY BUILT AS IRREGULAR URBAN BLOCKS: a cathedral with twin towers and a rose window standing beside the palace, guild halls with stepped gables, quarters of tall narrow timber framed burgher houses with terracotta roofs packed shoulder to shoulder with no gaps, several busy market squares with red and white striped awnings and laden stalls, workshops, granaries, stables and barracks, a river channel crossing the city with two stone arch bridges and a water mill with a wheel, quays with small boats, THE HOUSES JOINED WALL TO WALL INTO SOLID IRREGULAR BLOCKS of different sizes and shapes, each block a continuous mass of roofs ringed by its own narrow crooked lane, small enclosed courtyards, wells and back gardens hidden inside the blocks, the blocks crowding right up against the palace's own wall and packed out to the city walls with no open ground anywhere, definitely not concentric rings of houses and not rows radiating from the centre, an outer crenellated curtain wall with many round towers and a great barbican gatehouse, grand imperial scale

title: 城市 · City
subject: a walled medieval city on flat ground, at its heart a cathedral with a tall spire and a guild hall beside a small market square with striped awnings, THE HOUSES JOINED WALL TO WALL INTO SOLID IRREGULAR BLOCKS of different sizes and shapes, each block a continuous mass of terracotta roofs ringed by its own narrow crooked lane, small courtyards and wells hidden inside the blocks, the blocks packed right out to the walls with no open ground, a stone arch bridge over a mill stream running through the city, a crenellated curtain wall with round towers and one gatehouse, no castle

title: 城墙市镇 · Walled town
subject: a small walled medieval town on flat ground, a parish church with a square stone tower, THE HOUSES JOINED WALL TO WALL INTO THREE OR FOUR SOLID BLOCKS of timber framed buildings with steep tiled roofs, narrow crooked lanes between the blocks and back yards hidden inside them, a modest market place with a covered well and a few stalls, the blocks packed close against a low crenellated wall with four round towers and a simple arched gate

title: 市镇 · Open town
subject: an open medieval market town without walls on flat ground, a parish church with a shingled spire, THE HOUSES JOINED WALL TO WALL INTO TWO OR THREE SOLID BLOCKS of timber framed houses and workshops with tiled roofs, narrow lanes between the blocks and kitchen gardens behind them, a market cross and stalls in a small square, a tithe barn and a smithy at the edge

title: 村庄 · Village
subject: a medieval village on flat ground, a small stone chapel with a bell gable, ten cottages with thatched and tiled roofs standing gable end to the lane in two short terraces, a timber barn, a well, dry stone walls and vegetable plots behind the cottages, a cart standing by the lane

title: 小村 · Hamlet
subject: a tiny medieval hamlet on flat ground, four cottages with thatched roofs and lime plaster walls gathered tight around one small yard, a small timber barn, a well with a wooden roof, a woodpile and a fenced kitchen garden, no church and no wall
